classes.name: CachedCatalogLookupDataServiceDecorator<TLookupData, TReponse>
classes.description: Decorator class that adds caching behavior to a catalog lookup data service by utilizing local storage for cache management and expiration logic.

methods.name: CachedCatalogLookupDataServiceDecorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as local storage, catalog type service, and logger.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of catalog data, checking cache first, and loading from local storage if valid; otherwise, fetches from underlying service and caches the result.
